The weakest aspects are as follows:  First of all, this course is very demanding. It includes programming, research proposal, presentations, and article discussions. The programming parts are not covered in the class and students are expected to follow several tutorials on the internet to complete these assignments. Many of the concepts that are being mentioned in these assignments are poorly understood. Since the relevant articles are presented by the students, you cannot get a clear idea about the steps of the methods used in EEG research. Thus, if you are planning to take this course to get a good understanding of EEG methods I advise you not to take it. 'Cause, you will not obtain what you need. For example, if you were given an EEG dataset and you are expected to process it, you will not be able to do this just by this course material.
